labels.shortHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} (ag | agenda | agendamea)

Ordres de terminal i CLI (ag):
  ag                                 undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show 1                          undefined
  ag ok 1                            undefined
  ag rm 2                            undefined
  ag find <q>                        undefined
  ag undo                            undefined
  ag stat                            undefined

Servidor MCP (Integració d'assistent IA) / undefined:
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integracions de clients MCP
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Cua de sortida d'enviaments de webhook
  ag ai [status|models|download]     Estat del maquinari i models d'IA local
  ag doctor                          Comprovació de salut del sistema Agendamea (Doctor)
  ag help [cmd|all]                  Executeu "ag help" (ajuda d'ordre: "ag <cmd> --help", totes: "ag help all") per a l'ús.
labels.fullHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} - undefined

TASQUES:
  ag [today|imp|done|/Category]      undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show <1|id|keyword>             undefined
  ag edit <1|id|keyword> [fields]    undefined
  ag ok <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag rm <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag find <keyword>                  undefined
  ag matrix                          undefined

SUBTASQUES / CATEGORIES / PAPERERA:
  ag sub <task> [+ | ok | edit | rm] undefined
  ag cat [+ | edit | move | rm]      undefined
  ag trash [-q | delete | empty]     undefined
  ag undo [1|keyword]                undefined

CONFIGURACIÓ / SERVIDOR MCP (INTEGRACIÓ D'ASSISTENT IA):
  ag export / ag import / ag sync    undefined
  ag config [key value|--list]       undefined
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Cua de sortida d'enviaments de webhook
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integracions de clients MCP
  ag doctor                          Comprovació de salut del sistema Agendamea (Doctor)
